metadata.name: No Curse of the Blind
metadata.description:
No more "?" on pedestals. Curse of the Blind is gone for good.
But the curses want something back... Any floor that would have no curse gets an extra 15% chance to roll one: Darkness, the Lost, the Unknown or the Maze.
- Blind never appears, anywhere, any character. - No extra curse on Basement I, Blue Womb, Home, the Ascent, challenges, or with Black Candle. - The extra roll follows the floor seed: same seed, same curse.
Mod Config Menu (optional): turn the mod or just the extra curse chance ON/OFF.
